term.title: electronic transition

definitions.text: Transition in an atom, ion, or molecule from an electronic energy level \(E_{1}\) to another energy level \(E_{2}\).
sources: PAC, 2021, 93, 647. 'Glossary of methods and terms used in analytical spectroscopy (IUPAC Recommendations 2019)' on page 657 (https://doi.org/10.1515/pac-2019-0203)
